verification_scope: Independent reproduction of existing fixed models, plus separately disclosed requested 2026-11-21 main425 informative-group covariance sensitivity; no model search or new ecological hypothesis

independent_numerical_method.fixed_effects: Explicit site and region-by-season dummy matrix; pivoted QR orthogonal projection
independent_numerical_method.regression: NumPy pseudoinverse OLS on projected columns
independent_numerical_method.covariance: Sum of source-region block influence outer products times CR1
independent_numerical_method.source_cr1: G/(G-1)*(n-1)/(n-k); k counts retained slope columns, not absorbed FE rank
independent_numerical_method.intervals: Student t(G-1); P0-P1 uses the full joint covariance

main439_observation_support.criterion: Each listed exposure has sum of squared site + region-season FE residuals > 1e-16

new_20261121_main425_informative8_suppor.subset_rule: Each listed exposure has sum of squared site + region-season FE residuals > 1e-16
new_20261121_main425_informative8_suppor.interpretation: Dropping FE-absorbed single-site regions leaves coefficients and SSE unchanged, while the source CR1 correction and t reference use eight contributing groups. This is a post-result support sensitivity, not independent replication or proof of causal identification.

limitations: Reproduction uses the original already-selected historical optical pixels and frozen derived physical exposure; native satellite extraction is not repeated.
The mean outcome of the original-author 1000 calibration fits is reused; laboratory calibrations and their distribution are not refitted or independently validated here.
The nominal region-cluster intervals follow the original source convention and do not adjust for the prior exploratory search or guarantee small-cluster coverage.
Numerical agreement is not an independent biological replication, causal confirmation, new-era validation, direct diet measurement, or population forecast.

The temporal informative8 sensitivity was already frozen. The main425 informative8 covariance sensitivity is newly requested on 2026-11-21 and explicitly separated from original frozen 11-region intervals.
